title: Count the ones
task: Show on port 3 how many bits of the byte at x are 1, then stop. RAL and RAR do not set the flags: use ANI to test a bit. Keep the label x and its DB line; x is in the RAM, so your program may store into it.
starter:
; count-ones -- practice exercise (MAVILERA, SAP-2)
; Show on port 3 the number of 1 bits of x.
; Hint: eight times, test bit 0 with ANI 01H, then rotate x.
        HLT           ; replace with your code

        ORG 0800H     ; the data, in the RAM
x:      DB 0
